name: Shadcn Phone Input
summary: Phone number input component for shadcn/ui with country detection, formatting and validation via libphonenumber-js.
description: A formatted phone input component built with shadcn/ui and libphonenumber-js, with country data and ISO codes from the countries-states-cities-database project. The demo shows default and form usage, E.164 output, and a getPhoneData utility returning country code, calling code and international format for the selected number. The demo site is shadcn-phone-input-five.vercel.app.
contains: country data and ISO codes from countries-states-cities-database
getPhoneData utility: country code, calling code, E.164, URI
default and form usage shown in the demo
